ONE-VERSE EVANGELISM—WHAT IS IT?
Many people feel that to be effective in evangelism
they must memorize a complex illustration and a
multitude of verses, but the gospel can be powerfully
shared when it is done with love, clarity, and
simplicity.
One-Verse Evangelism is a simple, interactive way to
share Christ’s love conversationally and visually. It
is based on asking questions and sharing. It’s easy to
learn because it uses just one verse. And since it can
be shared in just 10 or 15 minutes, it enables you to be
sensitive to peoples’ busy schedules.
Below is a 4 week, 10 minute supplement for a Bible
study, ministry team, or discipleship group that will
help your group learn to share the gospel simply and
conversationally.
SOME TIME 1
ONE-VERSE EVANGELISM—WHAT TO DO
PRINT: Print: Print the One-verse Evangelism article
(print 1/person). http://crupressgreen.com/one-
verse-evangelism
TEACH YOURSELF: Read the One-Verse Evangelism
article and teach yourself how to explain the gospel
by illustrating Romans 6:23. (Don’t worry, it’s really
easy.) But talk through and illustrate Romans 6:23
with a friend or staff member at least once before
teaching your group. This will give you valuable
feedback, experience, and confidence as you lead.
WEEK-BY-WEEK GUIDE:
WEEK ONE
Intro: Introduce the One-Verse Evangelism concept
using the above description.
Read: Romans 6:23.
Memorize: Give everyone 3 minutes to memorize
Romans 6:23 on their own. Recite: After the 3 minutes
is up, ask members to repeat as much as they can from
memory in groups of 2 or 3.
Next week: Ask the group to memorize the verse
and let them know that you will be asking everyone to
repeat the verse from memory for the next 3 weeks.
WEEK TWO
Read: Romans 6:23.
Memorize: Give the group 2 minutes to memorize (or
re-familiarize) the verse on their own.
Recite: After the 2 minutes is up, ask each member to
repeat it from memory.
Demonstrate: Next, as the leader, demonstrate with
a group member what a Romans 6:23 conversation
might look like based on the One-Verse Evangelism
illustration in the article. (As previously noted, this
requires teaching this to yourself beforehand!)
Hand out the One-Verse Evangelism article
Next week: Ask students to be prepared to write
out and converse through the One-Verse Evangelism
diagram next week.
WEEK THREE
Recite: Each student repeats Romans 6:23 from
memory.
Practice: Pair students together and allow each to
take turns conversing and illustrating Romans 6:23.
WEEK FOUR
(Essentially repeat week 3, but repetition aids
learning!)
Recite: Each student repeats Romans 6:23 from
memory.
Practice: Pair students together and allow each to
take turns conversing and illustrating Romans 6:23.
Celebrate! Now students know the essence of the
gospel and can share it simply and conversationally!
Yay!
